title: Unique Product Affinity
scenario: Find the 'product_key' that was bought by the highest number of unique customers.
hint: Group by product_key, count distinct customer_id, order descending.
correctQuery: SELECT product_key FROM customer GROUP BY product_key ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) DESC LIMIT 1;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE customer (customer_id INT, product_key INT); INSERT INTO customer VALUES (1, 5), (2, 5), (3, 6);
